text: Starting cluster 24 (NULL semantics): built a 170-line VFP9 probe (retained ~/temp/vfp9-probes/null-semantics-c24). First PR covers #5934/#6140/#5942/#5979: comparison + arithmetic with a NULL operand are NULL (incl. string/date arithmetic and $); AND/OR/NOT are three-valued (.NULL. AND .F. = .F., .NULL. OR .T. = .T.); BETWEEN = (x>=a AND x<=b) in 3-valued logic (BETWEEN(5,.NULL.,2) = .F.); INLIST: NULL search value -> NULL, match beats NULL element, else NULL if any NULL element; EMPTY/ISBLANK(.NULL.) = .F.; NVL only for NULL; EVL(.NULL.,x) = NULL; NULL condition in IF/IIF/FOR acts as false. Probe findings for the REST of the cluster (not in this PR): nearly all built-ins propagate NULL (#5936) except ISDIGIT/ISALPHA/ISUPPER (.F.); non-Logical operands are ERRORS in VFP (1 = '1' -> 107, .T. + 1 -> 107, 1 AND .T. -> error 11, NOT 1 -> error 9), so #5939/#5940 are about failing, not coercing. Heads-up: a program that relied on NULL = 0 / NULL = '' now sees NULL, as in VFP.
